_comment: Hand-verified transcripts for voice clips the server data never writes down.
Most NPC voice acting has no line anywhere in the world DB: the client picks the clip
from an NPC's VOICE TYPE and the words exist only in the audio. That is ~250 clips,
and no amount of extraction reaches them -- someone has to listen.
Keyed by SoundEntries name (readable and stable across rebuilds; ids move when the
client is patched). The value is an array indexed by TAKE, matching the numbered
chips in the player and the `files` array in the `sounds` table -- so index 0 is the
first chip, which is the file the download button names '<Sound>-1.ogg'.
line here after actually hearing that take: a wiki lists what a voice TYPE says, not
which take says it, so copying a list in order would fabricate the mapping.
Per TAKE: a string overrides that take; an EMPTY string "" marks the machine
transcript for that take as wrong and suppresses it without inventing a line;
null (or a missing index) leaves that take to the machine.
build-db loads these into sound_text with src 'v', which makes them full-text
searchable exactly like a script-derived transcript.
